services.title: What We Do
services.subtitle: Full-cycle Bitrix24: installation, customization, automation, integrations, and custom development.
services.intro: We adapt Bitrix24 to your processes so your team can work in one place — without switching between tools.

items.title: Installation & Setup
items.description: We configure your Bitrix24 from scratch: initial setup, data migration from spreadsheets or other CRMs, server and security settings, and role-based access so everyone sees only what they need.

items.title: Customization
items.description: We align Bitrix24 with your workflows: custom fields and pipelines, branded interface, and processes that match how your sales and operations teams actually work.

items.title: Technical Support
items.description: Ongoing help when you need it: quick answers, diagnostics, updates, and best practices so your Bitrix24 stays stable and up to date.

items.title: Training & Consulting
items.description: We train your team on Bitrix24 and advise on structure and processes so adoption is fast and usage is effective from day one.

items.title: Automation
items.description: We design and set up automation for sales, marketing, and internal workflows so repetitive tasks run on their own and your team can focus on decisions.

items.title: Integration
items.description: We connect Bitrix24 with your existing systems: ERP, email, telephony, e-commerce, or custom apps via API, so data flows in one direction and stays in sync.

items.title: Application Development
items.description: We build custom modules, mobile extensions, and portal add-ons on top of Bitrix24 when out-of-the-box features are not enough for your business.

cases.title: Success Stories
cases.subtitle: Real results from Bitrix24 implementations — metrics, challenges, and outcomes

items.title: B2B Services Company: From Spreadsheets to Automated CRM
items.challenge: A growing B2B services company with 25 employees was managing leads and deals in spreadsheets and email. Sales reps couldn't track follow-ups, managers had no visibility into pipeline, and closing rates were declining.

solution.title: What We Did
solution.text: We implemented Bitrix24 Cloud with custom pipelines matching their sales stages, automated lead assignment and follow-up reminders, integrated email and telephony, and set up dashboards for real-time pipeline visibility.

items.title: E-commerce Business: Streamlined Operations and Customer Management
items.challenge: An e-commerce company with 40 employees was using separate tools for CRM, project management, and customer support. Customer data was scattered, order tracking was manual, and team communication happened across multiple platforms.

solution.title: What We Did
solution.text: We deployed Bitrix24 on-premise (EU data center), integrated it with their e-commerce platform via API, created custom workflows for order processing and customer support, unified team communication in one chat, and set up automated customer journey tracking.

after: Team chat and projects in one place
